description:
Cast Psychic Miasma by paying {1}{B}, targeting yourself.
Null Profusion triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
If Dakmor Salvage is in your graveyard, instead replace drawing a card with milling two cards, and returning Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Psychic Miasma, discarding Dakmor Salvage and returning Psychic Miasma to your hand.
Bone Miser's second ability triggers, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
